idea-plugin.name: withOhm
idea-plugin.description:
withOhm — AI traffic pipe for JetBrains AI Assistant.

Exact-match Redis prompt replay, BYOK OpenAI-compatible ingress, and compliant public-web fetch. This plugin does not reimplement tools; it registers the hosted ohm-mcp stdio MCP server so AI Assistant gets the same eight tools as Cursor and other MCP hosts.

Prerequisites

  • JetBrains IDE 2025.1+ with AI Assistant enabled
  • pip install withohm-mcp (ohm-mcp on PATH)
  • Tenant key from withohm.dev

Open Settings → Tools → withOhm, paste your sk-at-… key, apply.
